# secobserve_license_policy (Data Source)

Looks up a license policy by id or exact name.

This is the documented way to reference the seeded `Standard` policy without adopting it into Terraform, and to reference a policy for `secobserve_product.license_policy` / `secobserve_product_group.license_policy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reference the seeded "Standard" policy without adopting it into Terraform.
data "secobserve_license_policy" "standard" {
  name = "Standard"
}

resource "secobserve_product_group" "internal_tools" {
  name           = "internal-tools"
  license_policy = data.secobserve_license_policy.standard.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license policy. Supply either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the license policy. Supply either this or `id`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, even though SecObserve's own filter is a substring match.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_authorization_groups` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one authorization group member.
- `has_items` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one item.
- `has_product_groups` (Boolean) Whether at least one product group uses this policy.
- `has_products` (Boolean) Whether at least one product uses this policy.
- `has_users` (Boolean) Whether this policy has at least one user member.
- `ignore_component_type_list` (Set of String) Package URL types this policy skips entirely.
- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether the provider's identity is an explicit manager member of this policy. A superuser can manage the policy through the resource regardless of this flag.
- `is_parent` (Boolean) Whether at least one other policy has this one as its parent.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether every authenticated user can see this policy, not just members.
- `parent` (Number) Id of the parent policy, if any.
- `parent_name` (String) Name of the parent policy, or empty.
